acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four pinned Flutter fixture files is compared individually and mapped to a Rust-native counterpart or explicitly marked external/non-applicable.

Tri-language documentation explains Flutter fixture facts, unknown boundaries, shared external Runtime installation, explicit repository context, and adopter-owned Flutter/Dart checks without hard-copying source implementation.
Reference inventory, parity index, documentation links, and tri-language Work Item records bind the pinned source commit and remain synchronized.
The mapping does not claim direct compatibility with source-specific installer, Make, Python, guard YAML, or legacy JSON wire behavior.
Declared documentation, inventory, and conformance checks pass with installed Runtime evidence.
goal: Establish auditable semantic parity and inheritance boundaries for the four pinned examples/fixtures/flutter-app files.
intent: Compare the pinned Flutter fixture files one by one and record Rust-native/adopter mappings without copying Flutter-specific installation or legacy runtime behavior.
outOfScope: Flutter/Dart SDK installation or build orchestration
Changes to adopter repositories or global Agent/MCP configuration
Unrelated reference files and future batches
